title: epan: convert dissectors A-B to C99 types

notes.body: Did you find any interesting build failures after running the script?  Roughly how many did you need to fix up by hand?
The epan/wslua/make-taps.py script had to be append with std style. And there is always some gboolean that still need to be keep due to used in some g_hash function

It's hard to tell from a big MR which manual changes is needed, and I would like to be able to review only the manual changes. My concern here is that we merge "fixes to make it compile" without thinking about if it's a correct fix. Have a look at !16265 where I added a comment for the manual change needed.

We should think about how to do this before rushing to convert all dissectors in batches.

I understand the concern, and the make-taps.py did not have any handle of std style, only glib style. code generated was still the same after update. What manual code change I done is to restore some functions which returns gboolean due to ex `wmem_map_new` require that as input. Thus functions will have to be changed when `wmem_` is updated to std types.
Have a look at the discussion in #19116 before continuing converting dissectors. I think we should agree how to proceed this exercise as safe as possible, without doing too much manual work.

For the `wmem_` replacement I think that would require a second run with more manual step, not something a convert script can handle easily. And no conclusion yet of what it should be changed to, see https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/19116#note_1824762925
I'd like to merge this as the work has been done. Objections? Can we then proceed with the rest of the asn2wrs generated dissectors?
What about revert the changes from the ASN.1 generated dissectors? That should not make any conflicts. Converting the ASN.1 dissectors only need one manual wmem gboolean change in kerberos.

Sorry I do not understand that comment. There are lots of changes in the
.cnf and template files? Or do you mean we can do a separate MR with all
asn1 generated files done by the script?

I don't think you can go trough the ASN.1 files and make changes like this. These are taken from external sources as-is and processed though a script. If there's any changes to be made in generation the asn2wrs script would need adaptation.
100% agree, only c code should be changed.
Ah, my mistake. Correct .asn1 files should not be included!
